LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.NoPawns: No living pawns in the selected area.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.Sealed: A two-dimensional fragment of space containing {0}.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.ReleaseDesc: Release the original pawn into a nearby free cell. Its original faction is retained, including hostility. The empty sheet is consumed.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.NoReleaseCell: No safe free cell nearby. The pawn remains sealed.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.MustPlace: Place this sheet on the map first.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.FacingDesc: Cycle the displayed view: South → East → North → South. This does not change the pawn's original release facing.
LanguageData.PMP.Flatten.StudyDesc: Allow dark study through the sheet. Study uses the original entity's progress, unlocks and cooldown. No holding platform is required.
